2.name: Abjuration Savant & Arcane Ward
2.description: Half cost/time to copy Abjuration spells; weave an Arcane Ward absorbing up to 2 x Wizard level + INT mod damage.

6.name: Projected Ward
6.description: Reaction spends your Arcane Ward to absorb damage targeting an ally within 30 ft.

10.name: Improved Abjuration
10.description: Add your Proficiency Bonus to ability checks made for Abjuration spells like Counterspell and Dispel Magic.

14.name: Spell Resistance
14.description: Advantage on saving throws against spells and Resistance to the damage of spells.

2.name: Conjuration Savant & Minor Conjuration
2.description: Half cost/time to copy Conjuration spells; Action conjures a Small nonmagical inanimate object up to 10 lb.

6.name: Benign Transposition
6.description: Action teleports 30 ft or swaps places with a willing creature (1/Long Rest or Conjuration cast).

10.name: Focused Conjuration
10.description: Taking damage never breaks your Concentration on a Conjuration spell.

14.name: Durable Summons
14.description: Creatures summoned by your Conjuration spells gain 30 Temporary HP.

2.name: Divination Savant & Portent
2.description: Half cost/time to copy Divination spells; roll two d20s after each Long Rest and swap them into any visible attack, check, or save.

6.name: Expert Divination
6.description: Casting a 2nd+ level Divination spell regains one lower-level expended spell slot (up to 5th).

10.name: The Third Eye
10.description: Action grants Darkvision, Ethereal Sight, Greater Comprehension, or See Invisibility until next rest.

14.name: Greater Portent
14.description: Roll three d20s for Portent instead of two after each Long Rest.

2.name: Enchantment Savant & Hypnotic Gaze
2.description: Half cost/time to copy Enchantment spells; Action charms and incapacitates a creature within 5 ft while maintained (WIS save).

6.name: Instinctive Charm
6.description: Reaction diverts an attack within 30 ft onto a nearer creature (WIS save, resets on Enchantment cast).

10.name: Split Enchantment
10.description: Single-target Enchantment spells of 1st+ level can target a second creature.

14.name: Alter Memories
14.description: Creatures charmed by your Enchantment spells don't realize they were charmed and can forget hours of memory.

2.name: Evocation Savant & Sculpt Spells
2.description: Half cost/time to copy Evocation spells; protect up to 1 + spell level allies so they automatically save and take 0 damage from your Evocation spells.

6.name: Potent Cantrip
6.description: Enemies take half damage from your saving-throw cantrips even when they succeed on the saving throw.

10.name: Empowered Evocation
10.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell you cast.

14.name: Overchannel
14.description: Deal maximum damage on a 1st–5th level Wizard spell (free 1/Long Rest; escalating Necrotic backlash on repeats).

2.name: Illusion Savant & Improved Minor Illusion
2.description: Half cost/time to copy Illusion spells; learn Minor Illusion creating both sound and visual image at once.

6.name: Malleable Illusions
6.description: Action alters parameters of any ongoing Illusion spell lasting 1+ minute.

10.name: Illusory Self
10.description: Reaction forces an attack to miss by creating an illusory duplicate (1/Short or Long Rest).

14.name: Illusory Reality
14.description: Bonus Action turns one inanimate object inside an Illusion spell physically real for 1 minute.

2.name: Necromancy Savant & Grim Harvest
2.description: Half cost/time to copy Necromancy spells; regain 2x spell level HP (3x if Necromancy) when killing a creature with a leveled spell.

6.name: Undead Thralls
6.description: Add Animate Dead to your spellbook, animate +1 extra Undead, and add Wizard level HP + PB damage to your Undead.

10.name: Inured to Undeath
10.description: Resistance to Necrotic damage, and your HP maximum can never be reduced.

14.name: Command Undead
14.description: Action brings an Undead under your control via CHA save (indefinite if INT < 8).

2.name: Transmutation Savant & Minor Alchemy
2.description: Half cost/time to copy Transmutation spells; transmute wood, stone, iron, copper, or silver for up to 1 hour.

6.name: Transmuter's Stone
6.description: Craft a stone granting CON save proficiency, 60-ft Darkvision, +10 ft Speed, or Elemental Resistance (shareable).

10.name: Shapechanger
10.description: Cast Polymorph targeting yourself as a CR <= 1 Beast once per Short or Long Rest without expending a slot.

14.name: Master Transmuter
14.description: Destroy your Transmuter's Stone to cure all ailments, transform objects, restore youth, or cast Raise Dead.

2.name: Training in War and Song & Bladesong
2.description: Gain Light Armor, Performance, and one 1-handed melee weapon proficiency; Bonus Action grants +INT to AC, +10 ft speed, Adv on Acrobatics, and +INT on Concentration saves (PB/Long Rest).

6.name: Extra Attack (Bladesinger)
6.description: Attack twice when taking the Attack action, and optionally replace one of those attacks with casting a cantrip.

10.name: Song of Defense
10.description: Reaction during Bladesong expends a spell slot to reduce incoming damage by 5 x slot level.

14.name: Song of Victory
14.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to melee weapon damage rolls while Bladesong is active.

2.name: Arcane Deflection & Tactical Wit
2.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to Initiative; Reaction grants +2 AC against one attack or +4 to a failed saving throw.

6.name: Power Surge
6.description: Store charges when countering/dispelling magic to add +half Wizard level Force damage to spells.

10.name: Durable Magic
10.description: Gain +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws while concentrating on a spell.

14.name: Deflecting Shroud
14.description: Arcane Deflection blasts up to three creatures within 60 ft for half Wizard level Force damage.

2.name: Chronal Shift & Temporal Awareness
2.description: Add INT modifier to Initiative; Reaction forces any visible creature to reroll an attack, check, or save (2/Long Rest).

6.name: Momentary Stasis
6.description: Action freezes a Large or smaller creature in time until end of next turn or taking damage (INT mod/Long Rest).

10.name: Arcane Abeyance
10.description: Condense a 1st–4th level spell into a bead wearable and usable by allies within 1 hour (1/Short Rest).

14.name: Convergent Future
14.description: Reaction locks any visible attack/check/save roll to just succeed or fail, gaining 1 level of Exhaustion.

2.name: Adjust Density
2.description: Action halves (adv STR, +10 ft speed) or doubles (disadv STR, -10 ft speed) a Large or smaller creature's weight for 1 minute.

6.name: Gravity Well
6.description: Move a creature 5 ft when targeting it with a spell.

10.name: Violent Attraction
10.description: Reaction adds +1d10 damage to an ally's weapon hit or +2d10 to falling damage (INT mod/Long Rest).

14.name: Event Horizon
14.description: Action radiates a 30-ft gravity field halving hostile movement and dealing 2d10 Force damage + zero speed on failed STR save (1/Long Rest or 3rd+ slot).

2.name: Wizardly Quill & Awakened Spellbook
2.description: Rapidly scribe spells and swap elemental damage types of cast Wizard spells with any other spell of the same level in your spellbook; 1/Long Rest ritual takes 1 Action.

6.name: Manifest Mind
6.description: Bonus Action projects your spellbook's mind (300 ft range) allowing you to cast spells through its senses (PB times/Long Rest).

10.name: Master Scrivener
10.description: Craft a boosted magic scroll after every Long Rest (upcast +1 level) and craft scrolls at half cost/time.

14.name: One with the Word
14.description: Gain Adv on Arcana checks, and Reaction reduces incoming damage to 0 by dismissing Manifest Mind and temporarily losing 3d6 spell levels (1/Long Rest).
